foundation.pageTitle: Travio Ghana Foundation | Making a Difference Through Travel
foundation.heroTitle: Every journey can make a difference.
foundation.missionText1: At Travio Ghana, we believe tourism should not only create memorable experiences. It should also create a positive impact in the communities and destinations we serve.
foundation.missionText2: That's why we commit 2% of every booking revenue generated through the Travio Ghana platform to the Travio Ghana Foundation. Through this contribution, we support individuals, local communities, and community-led projects that need a helping hand.
foundation.missionHighlight: Whether it's supporting a family in need, contributing to a local community initiative, helping fund an important project, or supporting sustainable development, every booking with Travio Ghana helps us give back.
foundation.missionCta: When you travel with Travio Ghana, you're not just booking a journey. You're helping create a better one for someone else.
foundation.area1Subtitle: Helping people when they need it most.
foundation.area1Desc: A space for individuals who may need support or assistance. People can share their situation with us and tell us how Travio Ghana may be able to help.
foundation.area2Desc: We work with communities, local leaders, schools, organisations, and groups to identify needs and support initiatives that improve people's lives and create opportunities.
foundation.area3Desc: Explore the projects and initiatives supported by Travio Ghana, including education, environmental conservation, local development, and other community-focused programmes.
foundation.area4Subtitle: Together, we can make a greater impact.
foundation.area4Desc: We welcome partnerships with charities, NGOs, businesses, community organisations, and individuals who share our vision of using tourism as a force for good.
foundation.helpIntro: Whether you're an individual in need or a community seeking support, we're here to help. Reach out and let us know how we can make a difference.
foundation.individualSubtitle: Personal support when you need it most.
foundation.individualDesc: If you or someone you know needs support, we're here to listen. Share your situation with us and let us know how Travio Ghana may be able to help.
foundation.communityDesc: We work with communities, local leaders, schools, and organizations to identify needs and support initiatives that improve lives and create opportunities.
foundation.volunteerSubtitle: Give your time. Make a difference.
foundation.volunteerDesc: Discover opportunities to volunteer your time, skills, and experience through Travio Ghana' community initiatives and projects. Your contribution, no matter how small, can create lasting change in someone's life.

about.storyTitle: It all started with a simple idea
about.storyText1: Travio Ghana was built on a simple idea: make it easy for travellers to discover and book authentic experiences in Ghana, while giving local operators the platform they deserve.
about.storyText2: Every experience on our platform is reviewed and curated by our team to meet quality, safety and authenticity standards — so travellers can book with confidence.
about.calloutHeading: We connect travellers with hand-picked experiences across Ghana, from cultural tours to adventure activities.
about.calloutBody: Our mission is to make discovering those moments effortless — whether you're a first-time visitor or a seasoned traveller looking for something new.
about.badgeText: Quality, safety and authenticity checked before every experience goes live.
about.value1Text: Every tour on Travio Ghana is reviewed and curated to meet our quality, safety and authenticity standards.
about.value2Text: We work directly with local operators and guides who know their destinations best.
about.value3Text: Our suppliers meet clear safety and quality standards, and we vet every new experience before it goes live.
about.value4Text: The price you see is the price you pay. No hidden fees, no surprises.
about.value5Text: Our support team is here before, during and after your trip to help with anything you need.

careers.whyText2: We don't currently list open positions, but we're always interested in hearing from talented people who share our passion for travel and technology.

faq.needHelpText: Can't find your answer? Our team is happy to help.
faq.q1: How do I book a tour?
faq.a1: Browse our tours, select your preferred date and time, choose the number of travelers, and complete the checkout. You'll receive a confirmation email with all the details.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept major credit and debit cards, mobile money, and other local payment methods depending on your region.
faq.q3: Are prices per person or per group?
faq.a3: It depends on the tour. Most tours show per-person pricing, but some experiences are priced per group. Check the pricing section on the tour page for details.
faq.a4: Most bookings are confirmed instantly. Some tours require manual confirmation by the operator, in which case you'll receive a confirmation within 24 hours.
faq.a5: Yes, most tours offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts. Non-refundable tours are clearly marked. Check the cancellation policy on the tour page.
faq.q6: What happens if the operator cancels my tour?
faq.a6: If the operator cancels, you'll receive a full refund or the option to rebook another date. You'll be notified by email as soon as possible.
faq.a7: Refunds are typically processed within 5-10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.
faq.a8: The refund amount is based on the actual price you paid, including any applicable discounts.
faq.a9: Check the 'Meeting and pickup' section on the tour page. Tours that include pickup will list the available pickup areas and meeting points.
faq.q10: When will I receive my pickup details?
faq.a10: Pickup details are confirmed after booking. You'll receive the exact pickup location and time via email before your tour.
faq.q11: What if I miss my pickup?
faq.a11: Contact the tour operator directly using the phone number in your booking confirmation. They may be able to arrange an alternative meeting point.
faq.a12: Enter your promo code during checkout. The discount will be applied to your total if the code is valid for the selected tour and date.
faq.q13: Why did the price change after I viewed a tour?
faq.a13: Prices may change based on demand, availability, or special offers. We recommend booking when you see a price you're happy with.
faq.a14: You can reach us via email, phone, WhatsApp, or live chat. Visit our Contact Us page for all the details.
faq.a15: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Sunday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (GMT).

supplierTerms.s1Text: These Supplier Terms apply to tour operators, activity providers and independent guides who list their experiences on the Travio Ghana platform.
supplierTerms.s2Text1: Every supplier application is reviewed by our team before it goes live. We reserve the right to reject applications that do not meet our quality or safety standards.
supplierTerms.s2Text2: Certain activities are not permitted on the platform. Please refer to our platform guidelines for the full list of restricted activities.
supplierTerms.s3Text: You are responsible for keeping your listings accurate, up to date, and compliant with local laws and regulations.
supplierTerms.s4Text: There is no cost to add or maintain a listing on the platform. We charge a flat 15% commission on every successful booking.
supplierTerms.s5Text1: Client payments are consolidated and disbursed to you on a monthly or bi-weekly basis, depending on your preference.
supplierTerms.s5Text2: To receive payouts on time, you must provide your business registration details, tax identification number, and bank information.
supplierTerms.s6Text: You are responsible for delivering the experience as described in your listing. Cancellations by the supplier may result in penalties.
supplierTerms.s7Text: You agree to operate your experiences safely, professionally, and in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations.
supplierTerms.s8Text: We may suspend or terminate your account if you breach these terms, receive repeated complaints, or fail to meet our quality standards.
supplierTerms.s9Text: You retain the rights to the content you upload. You grant us a license to use your content for marketing and platform purposes.
supplierTerms.s10Text: We may update these Supplier Terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
